item.title: Lowndes County Emergency Management seeks community input for hazard mitigation plan update
item.description: Lowndes County Emergency Management is updating the county’s Hazard Mitigation Plan and is seeking input from residents to help identify and prioritize local risks and vulnerabilities.

item.title: Valdosta PD arrests suspect in Miami attack
item.description: Valdosta Police Department detectives arrested a suspect Wednesday in connection with an attempted murder in Miami.

item.title: Police hunt suspect in shooting
item.description: The Valdosta Police Department is seeking the whereabouts of Brandon Rashad James, 33, for his involvement in a shooting investigation.

item.title: Valdosta-Lowndes Chamber of Commerce celebrates three-year milestone for Pedro’s Tacos & Tequila
item.description: The Valdosta-Lowndes Chamber of Commerce recently celebrated a ribbon cutting with Pedro’s Tacos & Tequila in recognition of the restaurant’s three years of service in the Valdosta community.

item.title: Outdoor Living Southeast recognized as Leading Business of the Week
item.description: The Valdosta-Lowndes County Chamber of Commerce recently recognized Outdoor Living Southeast as the chamber’s Leading Business of the Week.

item.title: Senate votes to require candidates to raise at least half their money within Georgia
item.description: Republicans in the Georgia Senate passed a bill Friday that bans candidates from raising more than half of their campaign money from outside of the state, a limitation that Democrats said inhibits their fundraising in nationalized elections.

item.title: Senators vote to expand Georgia’s ‘stand your ground’ laws
item.description: The Georgia Senate approved a bill Friday that broadens “stand your ground” self-defense protections, a proposal that critics said would help protect defendants such as those who murdered Ahmaud Arbery.

item.title: Valwood students explore Spanish language and culture in Sevilla
item.description: Eight Valwood Upper School students recently participated in the Spain Mini Study Abroad program with Centro MundoLengua, an immersive experience designed to strengthen language skills and connect classroom learning to real-life Spanish culture.
